candidates.exact_span: All bulk sewage sludge that is applied to agricultural land, forest, a public contact site, a reclamation site, or lawn or home garden shall be treated by the Class A pathogen reduction requirements as defined above in Element I, Section I.B.3.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Applicability is conditioned on sludge being applied to specified site types; whether land application occurred and which site category applies determines if associated monitoring, recordkeeping, and reporting obligations are in force or whether a no-discharge/conditional-not-required state applies under Purpose C.

candidates.exact_span: All bagged sewage sludge must be treated by Class A pathogen reduction requirements.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Creates a separate applicability trigger for bagged sludge; interpreting whether sludge was bagged and subject to this requirement changes which monitoring and documentation obligations attach and whether conditional-not-required semantics apply when bagged sludge is not produced or applied.
